sources.quote: 7.1 The supplier shall obtain written approval from Aurelia (PPAP resubmission) before shipping parts
7.2 Aurelia shall be notified of every planned change at least 90 days before implementation.

findings.why: BR-220 (PRG-X) belongs to customer CUST-AUR. Revision 4 of the Aurelia manual replaces revision 3. It requires written approval (PPAP resubmission) before shipping after a change of coating or surface treatment, and notification 90 days ahead. Changing from COAT-ANOD to COAT-TCP is such a change. Revision 3 would only have needed 60-day notification, but it is no longer in force. No approval or notification for this change is in the documents.
